title: Loker HITL Response
description: UI-written human verdict at runs/<id>/responses/<phase>.json (HITL design §3.4). First-write-wins via claimed_by. inline_comments_path optionally points at a JSONL file with per-line/per-block annotations; when set, the engine renders comments into the verify result downstream.

inline_comments_path.description: Relative path under runs/<id>/. Null when no inline comments exist.
